title: Quantifying the Dialect Gap and its Correlates Across Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring performance disparities (via BLEU, SentenceBERT, WER, and CER metrics) between standard and minority regional dialects across multiple languages in machine translation and automatic speech recognition systems.

Calculating Pearson correlation coefficients between the relative performance drops of minority dialects and socioeconomic indicators of their speaker populations, such as GDP, GDP per capita, and Human Development Index (HDI).
